about: Worst-case Korean data for /hangul break: put these into a component on a throwaway stress page, then run break.mjs on it. Every value is synthetic (no real person, company or address). Use the slot that matches the field; the 'why' says what each one is meant to break.

companyName.why: one 27-syllable word with no space: keep-all cannot break it, so a fixed-width box overflows unless overflow-wrap: anywhere is set (HG-9, HG-10)

personName.why: a six-syllable name; split across lines it reads as two words

productName.why: Hangul, Latin and digits glued together: the browser may break at the script change, mid-word

wordWithParticle.why: a long compound with the particle attached; a break before 에서는 strands the particle

mixedCompound.why: Latin + Hangul compound in a heading or tab

price.why: the longest price; the unit stays attached to the number (HG-13) and the figure must not wrap

countZero.why: empty state: the component must say what zero means

countOne.why: singular: Korean has no plural, so '1개의 항목들' style output is an error

countMany.why: a capped badge; three digits plus a sign in a round badge

url.why: an unbroken token: needs overflow-wrap: anywhere (HG-9), never break-all on the whole block (HG-8)

email.why: an unbroken token in a form or a profile row

buttonLabel.why: a label written without spaces: a button that cannot grow either wraps mid-word or clips

tabLabel.why: a tab with no room to wrap: truncate with an ellipsis (HG-14) or let the tab bar scroll

address.why: a long address with numbers and a building name

sentenceMixedLevels.value: 결제가 완료되었습니다. 영수증은 메일로 보내 드려요.
sentenceMixedLevels.why: 합니다체 and 해요체 in one message: copy-check.mjs flags it (HW-11)

longParagraph.value: 이번 업데이트에서는 정기 결제를 등록한 고객이 결제일을 직접 고를 수 있게 되었습니다. 결제일을 바꾸면 다음 결제부터 적용되고, 이미 결제된 금액은 다시 청구하지 않습니다. 자세한 내용은 고객센터의 정기결제안내페이지에서확인할수있습니다.
longParagraph.why: body prose may break between syllables (HG-10), but the last unspaced run tests the column at 360px

single.why: the shortest text: badges and avatars should not collapse

empty.why: no value: the component shows a placeholder, not an empty box
